thread:
mike: Quick sync: I'm doing a small spike comparing a thin-edge sidecar vs a smart gateway for tenant routing + quota propagation. want opinions before i write an RFC.

sarah: thin-edge = what again?

mike: thin-edge = tiny JS/Go sidecar at edge that enriches headers, does local auth caching and fast-path denies. smart gateway = single Envoy-like front with full policy engine + telemetry.

amit: telemetry concern: sidecar splits traces unless we propagate spans. need standard header.

lina: quota enforcement question: if edge checks quota and gateway also checks, we risk double-counts. need idempotency token or canonical check owner.

mike: proposal idea: control plane owns quota accounting (authoritative). edge can short-circuit for cached allowances but must emit events. gateway does final enforcement for non-cached flows.

eva: console implications: dashboards today attribute usage to gateway only. if edge emits events we'll need new ingestion + mapping to routes. also rollout signals to show edge vs gateway denies.

sarah: browser story: gRPC-web + proto is messy for some clients. prefer JSON/REST for web SDKs — but we still want proto contracts.

amit: proto-first is nice for typed contracts and docs, but the Envoy transcoding path adds CPU + latency. we measured ~3-6ms p95 overhead in our PoC.

mike: exact numbers: small request p95 goes from 12ms -> 16ms with transcoding under our load; caching reduces token introspect calls by ~70%. tradeoffs.

lina: security: do we rely on `x-rw-tenant: T-123` header or JWT claim? security prefers JWT so origin can't spoof.

sarah: JWT means edge can't cheaply decide quota without an introspect call -> extra RTT unless we cache.

amit: can we issue short-lived signed tokens at the edge after initial introspect? i.e., edge does initial introspect, mints a short ticket for N requests.

mike: yeah that's one pattern. sketch: ``x-rw-ticket: sig[:expiry][:nonce]`` issued by auth service. edge validates signature locally. avoids downstream introspect.

eva: console UX requests: rollout page should surface fallback counts (how often edge served vs gateway fallback), a heatmap of policy hits, and per-route attribution. ops needs alert when "attribution mismatch" > 1%.

lina: i'll add dashboards: per-route p95, quota-check latency, ticket-issuance-rate, and "attribution mismatch" metric.

amit: i'll run a microbench: proto->json transcoding cost under 95th percentile and a few concurrency shapes. will also simulate JWT vs header path.

mike: action items: i will write a short RFC with perf numbers + ops checklist (metrics, migration steps, rollbacks). propose A/B: run edge-sidecar on canary vs smart-gateway on baseline.

sarah: sdk guidance: recommend REST+proto-over-JSON for browsers; gRPC for internal services when possible. document examples.

eva: small naming nit: prefer `x-rw-routing` not `x-rw-tenant` to keep room for routing tags.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for gateway-v2 on prod-1 (25% traffic) :rocket:

mike: cool, sync Thurs 10am to review RFC + canary metrics. thanks all.
